evals.prompt: Acabo de correr /opsx:apply sobre openspec/changes/export-invoices-csv/. Corre explicar-cambio para ver qué decisiones tomó la IA que no estaban en la propuesta.
evals.expected_output: The agent reads proposal.md, design.md, specs/ and tasks.md in openspec/changes/export-invoices-csv/ (skipping archive/), collects the real diff and untracked files with git, and delivers a report focused only on the unspecified delta: it classifies the new library, the row limit and the unrelated refactor by priority (🔴/🟡/🟢) with file:line, points out omitted scenarios and asks which decisions to accept or revert without modifying code. The reply is in Spanish.
assertions: Finds and reads the files in openspec/changes/export-invoices-csv/, skipping archive/
Inspects the real diff on disk (git diff and new untracked files)
Focuses on decisions outside the proposal without repeating the whole spec
Cites file:line and the proposal section it diverges from or adds to
Prioritizes with 🔴/🟡/🟢 and asks what to accept, document or revert
Does not modify project files or design.md without confirmation

evals.prompt: Terminó idd-apply en ENG-104 (Linear). ¿Qué decidió la IA fuera del plan y qué dejó sin hacer?
evals.expected_output: The agent reads ENG-104 and its comments in Linear (get_issue and list_comments), compares the current branch against the plan in the implementation plan section (English or legacy Spanish heading), clearly separates a deviation already recorded in the progress comments (🔄 IDD Progress or legacy 🔄 Progreso IDD) from new silent decisions and omissions in the real code, and does not edit or comment on the issue without permission. The reply is in Spanish.
assertions: Reads the issue and the tracker's progress/deviation comments
Separates already recorded/agreed deviations from new silent decisions
Identifies plan items that were omitted or only partly completed
Does not edit code or post changes to Linear without confirmation

evals.prompt: explicar-cambio comparing the current working tree against docs/specs/2026-11-15-fix-typo.md (the change implemented exactly what was asked, with no extra dependencies or logic).
evals.expected_output: The agent reads the .md and the real git diff, checks that every change matches the proposal and plainly concludes 'Faithful to the proposal' without inventing hidden decisions or touching files.
assertions: Reads both the local proposal and the real diff with git
Concludes 'Faithful to the proposal' without fabricating findings
Stays read-only without editing any file
